```tla
---------------------------- MODULE TwelveHourClock ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

VARIABLES hr

HCini == hr \in 1..12

HCnxt == hr' = IF hr = 12 THEN 1 ELSE hr + 1

HC == HCini /\ [][HCnxt]_hr

TypeInvariant == hr \in 1..12

Init == HCini

Next == HCnxt

Spec == HC

THEOREM HC => []HCini

================================================================================
```
